notes.title: WDC Charity Sale - Save the Whales!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that once again, we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation, for World Ocean Day!   

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save a fin-tastic 30% off Kingdom Rush, Kingdom Rush Origins, Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance, Iron Marines, Iron Marines Invasion, and Legends of Kingdom Rush. We will donate 10% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 


[h2]Who is WDC?[/h2]
[b]WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation[/b] is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  


[h2]What WDC has been doing so far 
[/h2]Working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 
[list]
[*] They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 
[*] They’re working with colleagues and partner organisations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbour porpoises. 
[*] On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 
[*] In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   
[*] These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean. 
[/list]

[h2]How your support will help this year
[/h2]By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 
[list]
[*]  Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living. 
[/list]

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused. 

[b]If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so [url=https://whales.org/ ]here![/url][/b]
Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does [url=https://games.whales.org/ ]here.[/url]
And you can find many other amazing games in the sale [url=https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale25]here.[/url]

[b]Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! [/b]
*10% of our net revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).

notes.title: KINGDOM RUSH 5: ALLIANCE, the next chapter in the saga, is on its way!
notes.content:
[b]We have a very big announcement to make!![/b]
[h1]Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance is coming soon![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34135725/ba174cace2fdbf6ea8c9888a09f3a1fa1ded2ab6.png[/img]

We’re cooking. And not spaghetti.  
Okay, maybe sometimes it’s spaghetti, but that's beside the point. What we mean is [b]the next Kingdom Rush game is in the works![/b]

Is it a Tower Defense? Absolutely. Is it full of our signature charm, gags and epic action? [i]You betcha![/i]
Have you seen the teaser? Check it out if you haven't already, or watch it again (we won't judge).

[previewyoutube=DhpkLRd8MJs;full][/previewyoutube]

We're still figuring out how to time-travel to the future to get the release date.

Change! It is as inevitable as it is clich d. All things must change, from your town and workplace to your bank balance and attitude towards seagulls (they are brilliant). One thing that does not change, however, is the endless deluge of games from Steam, and my place writing Unknown Pleasures.

Settling in for the long haul this week:

(more…)

notes.title: Report -The Raads
notes.content:
[h1]Commander! we just got our hands on this crucial information that may help us change the fate of this war![/h1]

The origin of the Raads is a mystery until this very day; however, we know for sure that they are creatures made of pure energy and that each Raad unit is composed of a single type of energy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/cc8504617e5dc56085136c29459b22ac71542688.jpg[/img]

They are intergalactic conquerors that travel through space destroying worlds and annihilating civilizations. They found a way to reach to reach our dimension on the past, where some of our powerful heroes, like Sparas and Trabuco, faced their scouting units, vanquishing them. Now that they have reached Borealis they had sent countless troops through their portal technology.

Since their homeworld belongs to a different dimension where the laws of physics follow different rules, to be able to survive in ours, they had to contain their energy in special suits.
Each Raad Unit can transfer their energy to a vehicle called Carrier and while piloting it, use their type of energy in powerful attacks.

The great Masters of the Raad, like Nexus, can only come to our dimension through high-powered portals but can manipulate energies of all types.

[h1]We need to stop their advances and free this dimension from their threat[/h1]

notes.title: Report -The Peripheroids
notes.content:
[h1][b]Commander, i have some new information on our Ascendaar enemies: the Peripheroids[/b][/h1]

Many eons ago, the Ascendii (an ancient robotic race that evolved on Ascendaar) embarked on a quest to find true knowledge.

They looked far and wide to find a superior intelligence that could guide them to evolve and interpret the mysteries of the universe for them, but their search was futile.

After much debate, they decided to fabricate an oracle of their own. A machine as close to a God as possible to answer their questions, and that's how Rob070 was born.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/99586e05c2c502eaaf7b5ecba5e5673944dc78f3.gif[/img]

Little did they know that from the moment it was activated, it would begin to create its own army: the Peripheroids, by systematically absorbing Ascendii, transforming them into its slaves while remaining as the supreme mind of Ascendaar. 

[b][h1]It is your duty, as an Iron Marine, to put an end to this madness and destroy its reign, returning the control of Ascendaar to its true owners.[/h1][/b]

notes.title: Report- the Fell
notes.content:
[h1][b]Commander, I have information about the newly discovered enemies: the Fell!
[/b][/h1]
As we know, these organic beings that invaded [b]Sagan-1[/b], our federation`s colony, were created by biologic manipulation from an unknown source.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/583a27b9c41e0881ccc5c34ba65947cf43e6b759.png[/img]

They evolve into different forms, and in spite of their primitive looks, they are incredibly intelligent and can adjust to the terrain.
The Fell work as a collective hivemind, with the bishop as the main guard and the Tyrant functioning as the mastermind.

[h1][b]They corrupt everything they touch, we need to eradicate them from the galaxy![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Heroes - Report 7

Commander:
I got a new report on our heroes, I am sure you will find it interesting

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/2bdaaf3b6fe1bac982ed7b3cb2782393dc45e84e.png[/img]

Blue Dragon is the perfect combination of steel nerves, sharp reflexes, and a focused mind; she is the most impressive and capable fighter pilot of the entire Federation. 
Her top-of-the-line starfighter is equipped with heavy machine guns, deadly missiles and the most devastating energy weapon of the entire fleet, that can fire blasts of energy to vaporize foes. She is assisted by the brave techbot, T-2  that is capable of making repairs, restoring the ship's health even during flight.

Trabuco is a Forlorn trooper, one of the most hardened races of the galaxy. A war veteran with hundreds of battles. He's inseparable companion is his Magnum .88 Duple that allows him to change his shot type between area effect shotgun or armor piercing laser blaster. He Likes to snack on Etherium to gain a regeneration factor, an achievement that only a handful of aliens in the galaxy can claim as their own.  Since he comes from a long lineage of warriors, he has trained himself and won't receive as much damage from the melee enemies compared to his other ranged counterparts 

[i]"Something to shoot at?"[/i]

notes.title: Heroes - Report 6
notes.content:
Commander,
 
I just got some classified information on two of our heroes that will help us set the strategy for this ferocious war

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/941b75a4b5afa759d54d711c1fc866c5ff46bd81.png[/img]

 Battle-hardened veterans were chosen to command the most powerful land-based vehicle, the Mark X Mobile Armored Unit. This tank has immense firepower, extreme precision to fire while on the move. The crew troopers jump out to fight enemies with shotguns and grenades every time extra support is needed. The tank can also disperse the most lethal of manmade poisonous gases that damage the foes and debilitates their armor. Combined with the crew ́s knowledge, survivability, and synchronicity, the Mark X is always ready to answer the call.

[i] "Ready to engage"[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/33ba32967bf1cd9a074268bf687c7da1ed81b074.png[/img]

Dr. Graaff is one of those unexplained and unrepeatable cases that defy science. What began as a military health care robot energized with an alloy of etherium,  developed into an autonomous and conscious entity. Too conscious perhaps, since its two main protocols are in constant conflict: Assist and Destroy. In an instant, he can go from firing blasts of deadly rays to reversing almost any kind of injury of his allies (or himself) with emissions from his etherium core. He is assisted by drones that he can overcharge and use almost as missiles as they crash into enemies at command. 


[i]"Unlimited POWER!"[/i]

notes.title: Heroes - Report 5
notes.content:
Commander:
I've got word of some outstanding heroes that are aiding our troops on the battlefield.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/6d26917b174ac5fa237726426b5b7529d770486b.png[/img]

Guiying is a mystic warrior of the Order of the Star Dragon; she trained all her life to become the Bearer of the Dragon Armor. This alien artifact channels the energy of a cosmic entity of incredible power, the Stellar Dragon, which materializes into a great protective dragon that stuns and deals damage to the enemy. With the aid of this artifact, she can create a replica of herself that watches her 6 and confuses the attackers, producing area damage in the process.  Every time she activates these powers she recovers some health and can even become ultra resistant. 

[i]"The Dragon stands ready."[/i]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/c0f2c7c26b3c5a86c10a48c9bcdd479cfe83237d.png[/img]

Roy is a gunslinger who has been in many battles and countless duels. Sometimes as a space sheriff and sometimes as a gun for hire. He is no oxygen thief, he may be short on words but fast with guns, and he fires hollow point rounds that deal extra damage and push enemies back. He likes to lit the battle up by throwing in his exploding firewater flask to roast all the opponents in the explosion area.
Dodging attacks and firing while walking are two of his many talents.

[i] "Do you need a gunslinger?"[/i]

notes.title: Heroes - Report 4
notes.content:
Commander! Our fight is far from over, and I have some information on two of our heroes that could help us change the fate of this war

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/2ccbb7120802e7974c62445edd1ea9abde5d0ee3.png[/img]

Sparas is an old explorer of unknown worlds that survived the harshest environments and interacted with the most strange alien living forms. He has tamed a few alien beasts to become his faithful companions and aid him in battle. He can either summon Tarrat, able to launch attacks from a great distance or Notadog, a ferocious biter. Sparras is so fearless he tamed a feared sheep from Falx-3, that can damage and stun enemies mercilessly.
He has personally overhauled his energy- net-cannon to fire all kind of special projectiles

[i]"The hunt is still on"[/i]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/09c99920bf24a396069e893406e411062b3464c8.png[/img]


Sha`Tra comes from a race of warriors from a destroyed world, a race of hunters almost extinct, 
He has traveled dozens of worlds, fighting in hundreds of battles and defeating thousands of enemies. Now his hunter instinct has brought him to us. Sha`Tra has some ticks under his alien sleeve. He can call his prove ship to abduct an enemy, and in the process deal double damage and win a few credits. He also has the power of summoning a fighter squadron (or even special fighters) that will obliterate anyone near him. It is rumored he possesses mysterious a  gem that allows him to increase his health and reduces his recovery time so he can return to battle faster.
[i]
"I didn't join your cause to stay here doing nothing. I'm a pred...hunter."[/i]

The Iron Marines have terrible enemies ahead and very hard battles, we are lucky to have them on our side.

notes.title: Heroes - Report 3
notes.content:
Commander! We have new incoming intel with information from two of our heroes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/3248b7634172b35e09aa6e7a9e1b2bb290cdc6ba.png[/img]

Ajax is a Mecha armored power suit piloted by the reckless pilot Mac, a wild and daring former troublemaker that proved his value in extraordinary battle accomplishments.
He can shake the ground, stunning his enemies, with a single punch or spin around, turning himself into a slice and dice machine, destroying any foe that dares to cross his path.
Not only can he deal loads of damage but also heals itself due to the incredible engineering and materials its made of. 
 
[i]“Let's get dangerous”[/i]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/d465abd7c6db3b6a4e0b7a184b3b28db7f2e0700.png[/img]

Darwin is a monkey that was trained to be the first astronaut sent into deep space with Etherium-based technology. Due to unfortunate circumstances, he crashed and used his artificially enhanced intelligence to build a personal propellant with some spare parts and the turbine of the ship. He can overcharge his turbine and fly, roasting all enemies around him. He infuses the enemy hearts with fear every time he pounds his chest, a primitive but effective move, lowering their attack power. From his long line of smart ancestors, he inherited the ability to move fast and can be back in battle faster than other heroes
[i]
“I´ll show you "evolution"!”[/i]

notes.title: Heroes - Report 2
notes.content:
Commander, 

While you set the strategy against the Fell, let me tell you about two powerful heroes that may help you achieve your plans:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/686c9de7311831c90a85cac48f48cfe5e7421f58.png[/img]

Paragon was created by the merge of 100 spirits of Masters Guardians that perished in battle and where raised together in this extraordinary entity. He can call out those spirits to haunt, damage and stun his enemies. 
When he is under heavy attack he can unleash healing energy to heal both himself and his allies. He is able to heal faster than most heroes, and can also dodge attacks so they have no effect on him.

[i]"I am the many"[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/9a9d64edc4dfdacb170a381317677489273d2d3f.png[/img]

Fate is the most mysterious Bounty Hunter of the Mercenary Guild, she is lethal, stealthy and cunning. Her advanced cloaking technology hides her from her enemies. She can deploy powerful explosive devices that will not only wipe out all enemies but also leave a toxic cloud or stun those lucky few that survived the blast. 
Since she is well connected with the black market she can upgrade herself and enhance her vision and attack damage.
Fate is an army by herself ... if an army could become invisible.

[i]"At your service...for a price"[/i]

notes.title: Heroes - Report 1
notes.content:
Great news from the front, Commander!
 
Two new Heroes have arrived to join the fight against the space monstrosities that infest the galaxy.
 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/268e09d03e8bf0c60784b2713fb5eeb36adc782d.png[/img]

Taggins is a battle-hardened Captain, equipped with an amazing shield that makes him immune to damage, and loaded with powerful Uranium ammunition. 
We’ve heard that his suit is able to improve and enhance his defense, even making him capable of dodging attacks

[i]"Ready for action".[/i]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/568f16f154314133b7fd208696507a0c374de0ae.png[/img]

Kara is a hero that excels at shooting down airborne enemies. She was a  brilliant mining Engineer on Sagan-1´s colony when it was invaded by the Fell, so she used her knowledge and skills to customize her suit with missile cannons to fight back. She can spin around to attack nearby foes and send her hand made missiles to attack over barriers to make those creatures meet their end. 
Her work with heavy ordnance has improved her attack range, and she will jump back to battle, even after being defeated, faster than most heroes.

[i]"You point, we shoot"[/i]


With their powers and your cunning leadership, the alien scum won’t stand a chance against us!

notes.title: Loading Landing
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/2cec48a742df18d24fddfca7a7054d480a0d2793.png[/img]

Greetings commander:

We had to delay our arrival to Steam to make sure we have all the equipment we need to make our mission successful and provide you with the experience you deserve.

Our new arrival date will be on the 15th of May

We apologize for the inconveniences but we can promise it will be worth the wait.

notes.title: Travel log - Entry 3
notes.content:
We finally managed to have some time to log this entry as we have been busy establishing commercial bonds with the local resident species of Borealis: the Ga’r. A friendly and prolific race, that is well adapted to the constant blizzards, bone-breaking cold, and hostile fauna of this planet.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/ca0832573c061210e3aaf1385e2c48545599f5a7.png[/img]


We also encountered the Fenrir, a sneaky type of arctic wolves, that is one of the biggest threats Borealis holds. These dangerous predators prowl around the snowy desert in search for their next meal.
 
A word of caution to the colonizers, while negotiating with the locals we were caught by surprise by an attack from a foreign species: the Raad, this beings have opened portals from an outer galaxy and are fighting to take control of the planet. They must be stopped!


We managed to register an image while defending the Ga'r village

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/923cd7ce3a13dcee3efb7143f947d714f5c38937.png[/img]

notes.title: Travel log - Entry 2
notes.content:
Our travel continue, after leaving the misterius Sagan-1 we land in Ascendaar. 
It seems to be the home of intelligent machines built to defend their territory. Under the command of one gargantuan super-robot, the peripheroids make sure trespassers get a proper welcome.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/83b8ae1e6c072a8ab8a38ab38e2b17e23161f717.png[/img]

We catch sight machines built with impressive weaponry. The mechanized inhabitants of Asceendar are as varied as they are deadly, each one designed using cutting edge Peripheroid military technology to create impenetrable security forces. Their main directive: Keeping carbon-based life forms at bay.

This is the only image that we can register:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/adcfb6d03fd05a200fdbf163c3848c7e94f4d14c.png[/img]

notes.title: Travel log - Entry 1
notes.content:
[b]Today we land in Sagan-1,[/b] the fittest place to establish humanity's first mining colony. We are almost deceived by the colorful environment, but Sagan-1 is the home of unknown alien lifeforms.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/f47080a1490a5bf39884ad54fc5ccf3981188b49.png[/img]

We have the first register of dangerous aliens. 
[b]Species:[/b] Fell
[b]Description:[/b] It seems that they have just arrived to the planet in a rain of cocoons. The Fellwright is a race of flesh-bending aliens with a remarkably adaptive genome that allows them to assimilate and mutate other life forms to serve their vile Etherium-fueled goals.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34135725/9ef829355240052d597dcf8a87069d681f77d8e4.png[/img]

We will continue studying this planet and the creatures that inhabit it.
